hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */domains/*/specs/*.md) [ "$(basename "$f")" = "_template.md" ] || printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"A spec under domains/*/specs/ was just written or edited (%s). Before treating this spec as ready, run the carryover-auditor agent against it to catch any prior-blueprint lesson it failed to carry over."}}' "$f" ;; esac; }
